narr: A line of thunderstorms preceding a cold front dropped into north-central Illinois during the pre-dawn hours of July 15th. Several cells trained over the same locations, with Doppler radar rainfall estimates of 2 to 4 inches across southern Marshall County. The heavy rainfall prompted the closure of several roads, including Illinois Route 17 between Lacon and Sparland.
ev: Illinois Route 17 was closed between Lacon and Sparland due to water flowing across the road.
A culvert was washed out on Illinois Route 29 near Sparland, which swept a vehicle off the road. No injuries were reported.
lsr: RT 17 CLOSED DUE TO WATER OVER THE ROAD.
